variant.title: Magic Square Sudoku
variant.description: The marked 3x3 region is a magic square: each of its rows, columns, and main diagonals sums to 15.
rule.magic_square: Every row, column, and main diagonal in the marked 3x3 region sums to 15.
rule_guide.title: Magic Square Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: In the marked 3x3 region, each of its three rows, three columns, and two main diagonals must sum to 15.
rule_guide.item_3: Unmarked 3x3 boxes have no extra magic-square restriction.
